title: standardize-retry-after-idempotency-streaming-openai-compat
author: Asha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: several customer reports and internal canary runs exposed inconsistencies between the Redwood API and the OpenAI compatibility layer around rate-limit headers, idempotency behavior for streaming/function calls, and structured error payloads. This PR standardizes Retry-After semantics (supporting both seconds and HTTP-date), makes idempotency key handling consistent across non-streaming and streaming endpoints (including function/tool calls), and unifies error codes and structured error fields to match our OpenAI compat contract.

What changed (high level):
- Standardized Retry-After parsing and emission across gateway, compat layer, and gateway->runtime routing. We now accept integer seconds and HTTP-date and always surface Retry-After in the API response when the rate limiter triggers.
- Idempotency: moved to a shared middleware that is applied to /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses (new API), and streaming socket endpoints. The middleware persists in Redis with a TTL consistent with the response lifetime and supports partial-stream-commit markers for streaming responses (so retrying an interrupted streaming request resumes if the idempotency key and model/params match).
- Streaming behavior: added explicit terminal/error frames for streaming function/tool-calling so clients receive a consistent structured error event when we abort early due to quota or rate-limit. This fixes flakiness where some client SDKs interpreted partial event sequences inconsistently.
- Error schema: unified structured error fields (type, code, message, retriable, retry_after) across compat and native endpoints. 429 remains for rate-limited requests; when idempotency conflicts are detected we return 409 with a standardized "idempotency_conflict" code.
- OpenAI compat: updated compat layer to translate native rate-limit metadata into the OpenAI-compatible headers and body fields. Also added a conservatively backward-compatible change to include "x-openai-compatible" metadata in error payloads for monitoring.
- Tests/e2e: added unit tests for Retry-After parsing/emission, idempotency middleware tests (including streaming resume cases), and integration tests that exercise the gateway->runtime flow under rate-limited conditions. Added a headroom canary that exercises streaming tool-calls under contention.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add Retry-After parsing/emission across layers
- [x] Move idempotency to shared middleware and add streaming resume markers
- [x] Add terminal/error frames for streaming function/tool calls
- [x] Unify error schema and map to OpenAI compat fields
- [x] Add tests and canary pipeline
- [x] Update docs and SDK compatibility notes

Related: Linear ENG-3421 (rate limit semantics), ENG-3987 (streaming reliability), PM-112 (OpenAI compat contract updates).
